fields.narration: STARTEX. This is an exercise. It is 09:00 on Thursday, October 22, 2026, at the Teague Valley Chemical Company, Corbin Falls Works. The plant is at normal load. Loading of a 90-ton chlorine rail tank car from TK-32 at Rail Spot 2 began at 08:40. Corbin Falls Elementary School is in session. Begin monitoring your systems and channels.
